userStories.title: Create useSubagentSelection hook with persistence
userStories.description: As a user viewing the subagents tab of the Manage Tools modal, I want my subagent selections to be saved automatically so that I don't have to re-select my preferred subagents every time I refresh the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Add subagents: string[] | null to DefaultsResponse interface and patchDefaults parameter type in frontend/src/lib/services/userSettingsService.ts
Create frontend/src/components/modals/ToolSelectionModal/hooks/useSubagentSelection.ts mirroring useToolSelection pattern
Hook manages a Set<string> of selected agent IDs
Hook has debounced persistSubagents() that calls patchDefaults({ subagents: [...] }) with 500ms delay
Hook has toggleSubagent(agent) that adds/removes IDs and updates agent.subagents via AgentContext
Hook has getAuthToken() guard that skips API calls for unauthenticated users
Hook has flushPersist() that clears pending debounce timer
Toast error appears if save fails: 'Failed to save subagent defaults'
Wire hook into ToolSelectionModal/index.tsx replacing direct useAgentContext() calls for toggleSubagent and isAgentSelected
Call flushSubagentPersist() in handleClose of ToolSelectionModal
Typecheck passes (npx tsc --noEmit from frontend/)
Lint passes (npm run lint from frontend/)

acceptanceCriteria: Modify settings loading useEffect in frontend/src/components/menus/BaseToolMenu.tsx to also extract defaults.subagents

Add a second useEffect watching [agents, pendingSubagentIds] that resolves IDs to Agent objects once agents list is available
Set resolved agents onto agent.subagents via setAgent
If a saved agent ID no longer exists (agent was deleted), it is silently filtered out with no error

The subagent badges/indicators in the UI reflect the loaded defaults after page refresh

userStories.title: Add tag filter chips to Platform tools panel
userStories.description: As a user viewing the Platform tab in the Manage Tools modal, I want clickable tag filter chips above the tool grid so that I can quickly narrow down the 20+ tools to a specific category instead of scrolling through the entire flat grid.
acceptanceCriteria: An 'All' chip is shown by default and is active on initial render
One chip is rendered for each unique tag derived from the tags[] field on loaded platform tools
Each chip displays the tag name and count of tools with that tag, e.g. 'search (3)'
Clicking a tag chip filters the grid to show only tools whose tags[] includes that tag
Clicking 'All' clears any active tag filter and shows all tools
Only one tag chip can be active at a time (radio-style, not multi-select)
Tag filtering works in combination with the existing text search -- both narrow results simultaneously
Tags with zero matching tools (after text search filtering) are visually dimmed but still clickable
The chip bar is horizontally scrollable on narrow viewports (mobile)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill

userStories.title: Add batch enable/disable tools by tag category
userStories.description: As a user who has filtered by a tag, I want 'Enable All' and 'Disable All' buttons visible when a tag filter is active so that I can quickly toggle all tools in a category without clicking each card individually.
acceptanceCriteria: When any tag filter (not 'All') is active, 'Enable All' and 'Disable All' buttons appear in the toolbar area next to the tag chips
'Enable All' selects every tool currently visible in the filtered grid
'Disable All' deselects every tool currently visible in the filtered grid
The buttons are hidden when the 'All' chip is active (prevents accidentally toggling every tool)
Batch actions use the existing useToolSelection.selectMultiple() for enabling
Add deselectMultiple(tools: string[]) method to useToolSelection hook as counterpart to selectMultiple
Persistence happens via the existing debounced patchDefaults({ tools }) flow -- no extra API calls
The status bar at the bottom updates immediately to reflect the new selected count
A toast confirms the action: 'Enabled 3 search tools' / 'Disabled 3 search tools'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill
